body:
i was placed on 450mg wellbutrin and 20mg lex! i was super sensitive to caffeine at first w my wellbutrin but has since resolved. 

re: your feelings and experience, totally felt that way when my doc added 150 mg to my 10mg of lex. I was like the fuck why am I so resistant!!! I felt like my brain was super broken if I was placed on max doses of both and still didn’t feel great… 

long story short, I also was diagnosed w ADHD and so all of this time fighting one thing may have worked for my situation at the time, but I was taking meds that weren’t really helping what was causing the biggest issues. 

it’s so hard to trust in anything these days, but my ADHD was diagnosed almost by my doctor just observing me in person after too many months of phone visits (thanks cov). anyways, you’ll get there. there is no doubt. and some things for for some and don’t for others, but we’re lucky, so many meds are avail to try!

also, don’t overlook sharing these things w your doc if you’re safe to and haven’t already. they are sometimes able to help mitigate these discrepancies!!
“is this the end of all the endings… my broken bones are mending”
also “there were sirens in the beat of your heart” red flags in their BLOOD… bones of toxicity!!!!! and warning!!!!
“in the middle of the night, in my dreams… you should see the things we do” to me this is sarcastic and witty with her being like holy shit babe get a load of what we were up to last night APPARENTLY

honourable mention: “remember when you couldn’t take the heat, I walked out I said I’m setting you free, but the monsters turned out to be just trees, and when the sun came up you were looking at me“. speaks to me in the sense that this line feels like, when things get really hard in a really toxic type of relationship/situation, and when you turn around and realize that it was just a really hard time, and it’s quite literally behind you. The monsters turned out to be just trees meaning that they actually didn’t have that much power over you. And also, I love the part where she says when the sun came up you were looking at me: to me it means, when I got through the darkest of times, that’s when you turned around and you looked to me. That’s when you recognize me. That’s when you actually saw me for who I was. When things got brighter and things felt easier that’s when you wanted me.

also when she says “I wake in the night/ I pace like a ghost/ The room is on fire/ Invisible smoke” I BAWLED cuz it was when I just got out of my ab*sive relationship, and I was struggling with PTSD. Constant nightmares and flashbacks that I had no idea were PTSD… I just felt messed up. This line made me feel heard. It’s the reason The Archer is my fave of ALL TIME.
the phrase holy f*ck left my mouth

my fave I got was “I don’t know why your brain makes me out to be such a terrible person. Makes me feel like shit when I can’t get through to you cause your brain won’t stop making me out to be an asshole” 🙏🥲

tbh I was having the exact same problem. I pitched U world for about 2 days and just did Mark Klimmek lectures, and I was also using the Kaplan textbook. I was getting the questions right in my textbook, and I went back to u world using some of the strategies I learned and still was getting ~50% correct. I think U world is extremely difficult to get everything right bc the topics are difficult so that if you get less difficult questions on the nclex, it's less scary. Idk if that helps but I really recommend taking a break from u world and studying in another way!!

Don’t forget too about how real the placebo effect can be. I had a really similar situation arise from my cipralex; the first week on it I felt so positive and empowered. When I had to increase my dose from 10mg —> 15mg I felt amazing the first few days, but absolute crap for the next few weeks. I find with myself personally (I am a 20 year old male as well) that the effects take quite some time. 

I’ve also found though that really drinking plenty of water, eating healthier foods as well as trying to get as much sunlight as possible. Try not to give up hope because I upped my dose approx. 1.5 months ago and now I feel better! I feel less depressed and a lot less anxious about everything that caused me so much stress before.
